about: M9 HELD-OUT key (T19, key ruling 1 §conditions 2), written and committed BEFORE the call-graph path (option A) existed and before any similarity score, re-anchor run or option A code touched these pairs. cases: every candidate pair produced mechanically by bench/m9-heldout-builder.ts (same pairing rules as bench/m9-key-builder.ts: same file, git -M renamed file, cross-file when token Jaccard >= 0.5) over the hermes-agent ui-tui TS/TSX history, newest commits first. Each pair was LABELLED BY HAND from reading the declarations and the commit diff lines naming the old/new symbol (label + reason), with the same 3 labelRules as m9-key.json; a positive reason cites body or role continuity, not only switched callers. Hard negatives (generalizations, merges, splits, replacements, surviving names) are kept as they came.
labelRules: rename: same role, callers (if any) now use the new name, normalized body identical except the symbol's own name
rename+change: same role continued under a new name (callers switched, or the old code is the clear bulk of the new symbol) and the body was edited
not-rename: the old symbol was dropped, split across several new symbols, or merged with another into one generalized symbol (no single successor), or the bodies are too small to tell
stopRule: fixed before labelling, on label counts only: walk the ui-tui TS/TSX commits newest first from the pinned head and stop after the first commit at which the running count of expected re-anchors (rename + rename+change) reaches >= 20; every candidate pair of the commits walked so far is in the key

stop.note: walk = position in `git rev-list --no-merges <head> -- ui-tui/*.ts ui-tui/*.tsx`; 600 commits were generated, the 9 pairs of walk 529-557 were labelled too but lie past the stop and are not in the key

thresholds.similarity: Dice coefficient over token bigrams: TypeScript tokens of the declaration with trivia removed, the symbol's own name replaced by $SELF and (methods) its class name by $CLS
thresholds.callerBand: option A (ruling 1 §4, constants exactly as in 4 log/key-changes.md): 0.40 <= similarity < renamedChangedMin re-anchors only when >= 1 caller of the old name in the parent tree still exists in the new tree and now references the candidate, one-to-one (no rival vanished symbol, no rival candidate), never under minTokens; outcome always renamed+changed (stale), never fresh
thresholds.note: fixed before this key was scored; REANCHOR must carry these exact values or the held-out bench reports thresholds match key false

scoring: per old symbol: expected = its rename / rename+change pair if any, else none. right = re-anchored to the labelled symbol with the labelled outcome (rename -> renamed/fresh, rename+change -> renamed+changed/stale). wrong = re-anchored to any other symbol, or re-anchored when expected none. silentFresh = rename+change reported as renamed (fresh). Target: right >= 95% of expected re-anchors (held-out cases), wrong = 0, silentFresh = 0. Band check (ruling 1 §5): count the old symbols whose best key candidate (labelled target for positives, best candidate for negatives) has key similarity in [0.40, 0.55); fewer than 5 = inconclusive.

hermes.note: hermes-agent is a blob:none partial clone: the bench reads it through a bare scratch repo whose objects/info/alternates points at ~/.hermes/hermes-agent/.git/objects (promisor remote origin, gc.auto 0) so lazily fetched blobs land in scratch, never in hermes-agent. Recreate: git init --bare <path>; echo ~/.hermes/hermes-agent/.git/objects > <path>/objects/info/alternates; set core.repositoryformatversion 1, extensions.partialClone origin, remote.origin.url https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git, remote.origin.promisor true, remote.origin.partialclonefilter blob:none, gc.auto 0. The bench exits 2 when it is missing.
